list.title: Projects
list.errorFallback: An error occurred while fetching projects.

empty.title: Create your first project
empty.description: Set up a project with a stage schedule to start capturing project items from meetings, emails, and documents.

archiveDialog.title: Archive Project?
archiveDialog.body: This will archive the project. It can be restored later.
archiveDialog.error: Failed to archive project. Please try again.

create.title: Create New Project
create.error: Failed to create project. Please try again.

edit.title: Edit Project
edit.error: Failed to update project. Please try again.

sharing.title: Organizations with access
sharing.description: Share this project with another organization. Contributors can add meetings and items; viewers can only read.
sharing.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this project? Its members lose access immediately.

errors.owner: This project already belongs to this organization.
errors.generic: Could not update access. Please try again.

participants.title: Participants
participants.empty: No participants added. Add team members to improve AI discipline inference.

stages.title: Stage Schedule
stages.empty: No stages defined. Add stages or load a template.
stages.replaceConfirm: This will replace existing stages. Continue?

fathomRules.title: Fathom rules
fathomRules.description: Meetings that arrive from Fathom automatically go to this project when they match any of these rules. A meeting that matches no project, or more than one, waits in Ingestion for someone to pick the project.
fathomRules.empty: No rules yet: Fathom meetings do not come to this project on their own.

errors.invalid: Check the value: it cannot be empty or longer than 200 characters, an email needs an @ and a domain has no @.
errors.generic: Could not save the rule. Try again.

driveFolder.title: Google Drive folder
driveFolder.description: Documents (PDF and DOCX) added to this folder, including later ones, appear in Ingestion for review.
driveFolder.notConfigured: Google Drive is not enabled on this server yet.

howTo.title: How to connect a folder
howTo.step1: Open the folder in Google Drive and click Share.
howTo.step3: Come back, click “Refresh list” and pick the folder.
howTo.note: Only folders shared by people in your organization are listed.

driveFolder.noOptions: No shared folders yet. Share the folder with the e-mail above and click “Refresh list”.
driveFolder.removeConfirm: Stop monitoring this folder? Documents already imported stay in the project.

errors.folder_not_accessible: We cannot reach the folder. Is it still shared with the e-mail above?
errors.poll_failed: The last folder check failed. We will retry automatically.
errors.folder_not_shared_by_organization: This folder was not shared by someone in your organization.
errors.folder_in_use: This folder already feeds another project. A folder can feed one project only.
errors.drive_unavailable: Google Drive did not answer. Try again in a moment.

externals.title: External people
externals.description: Invite anyone by e-mail to follow this project only. Viewers only see shared meetings; contributors can also add items and meetings.
externals.created: Invitation created for {{email}}. Copy the link and send it to them (it is shown only once):
externals.empty: No external people on this project.
externals.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from this project? Their access ends immediately; what they added stays.

errors.already_member: This person is already a member of the organization.
errors.already_invited: This person already has external access to this project.
errors.generic: Could not update external people. Please try again.
